title: New for Unity Industry: Automotive HMI sample for embedded-style hardware
summary: Unity Industry HMI template: An automotive HMI sample with instrument cluster, ADAS view, climate controls, and city sim, targeting constrained, embedded systems
body_markdown:
Our new[Unity Industry](https://unity.com/products/unity-industry) automotive HMI (human-machine interface) template, for Unity 6.3 or later, is now available to download in the Unity Hub.


This is an updated version of the HMI template released in 2021. It runs up to 60 fps on a Linux-based Raspberry Pi 5 to show performance on embedded-style hardware. It includes a digital instrument cluster, an interactive 3D vehicle, climate controls, an advanced driver assistance system (ADAS) backed by a live traffic simulation, and a theme system that updates the colors of UI elements.


The new HMI template demonstrates automotive[HMI workflows in Unity Industry](https://unity.com/solutions/human-machine-interface-hmi) with swappable data, vehicle features, and UI layers so developers can use it as a foundation for their own HMI projects.
